name: Mailman
description: Mailing list manager for running announcement and discussion lists with a web archive.

envVars.description: Django secret key for the web archive

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_TYPE: postgres
      DATABASE_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      DATABASE_PASS: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      SECRET_KEY: {{env.SECRET_KEY}}
      MTA_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-core"
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/web-data:/opt/mailman-web-data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: mailman
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: mailman
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-core:
    image: maxking/mailman-core:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-core
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DATABASE_TYPE: postgres
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://mailman:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres/mailmancore"
